title: Borel gluing of functions along disjoint injective continuous images of Borel sets
statement: Let m, d ∈ ℕ and, for i ∈ ℕ, let F_i : ℝ^m → ℝ^d be continuous, B_i ⊆ ℝ^m Borel with F_i injective on B_i, and h_i : ℝ^m → ℝ Borel with h_i ≥ 0 everywhere. Assume the images F_i(B_i) are pairwise disjoint. Then there is a Borel J : ℝ^d → ℝ with J(v) ≥ 0 for every v and J(F_i(b)) = h_i(b) for every i ∈ ℕ and every b ∈ B_i.
lean_statement: ∀ (m d : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Euclid m → Euclid d) (B : ℕ → Set (Euclid m)) (h : ℕ → Euclid m → ℝ), (∀ i, Continuous (F i)) → (∀ i, MeasurableSet (B i)) → (∀ i, InjOn (F i) (B i)) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (F i '' B i) (F j '' B j)) → (∀ i, Measurable (h i)) → (∀ i a, 0 ≤ h i a) → ∃ J : Euclid d → ℝ, Measurable J ∧ (∀ v, 0 ≤ J v) ∧ ∀ i, ∀ b ∈ B i, J (F i b) = h i b
